title: FormalSystemCompletedAffineSections
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ an ideal sheaf and $U\subseteq Y$ an affine open. Put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and let $g:S\to Y$ be the completion map followed by the inverse affine chart and inclusion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-pc-module-pullback]. For every coherent formal $J$-system $G=(G_n)_{n\geq0}$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], with $J^{n+1}G_n=0$ and its specified transitions, there is an isomorphism of $\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}$-diagrams of $B$-modules $e_G:(\Gamma(U,G_n))_n\simeq\operatorname{Res}_{B\to R}(\Gamma(S,g^*G_n))_n$. These isomorphisms can be chosen naturally for all formal morphisms: for every $a:G\to H$, $\Gamma(U,a)e_H=e_G\operatorname{Res}_{B\to R}(\Gamma(S,g^*a))$ as natural transformations of diagrams. No Noetherian assumption on $R$ is needed, and neither a proper morphism nor an inverse limit occurs.

source.place: Proof, completed-base change paragraph; Tag 05GG quotient formula and Tag 01I9 affine pullback sections

proof.text: For each level of a coherent formal system, coherence on a Noetherian scheme implies quasi-coherence. The affine sections adic theorem gives annihilation by J(U)^(n+1).

Apply the power-torsion sheaf comparison to each term. Its natural transformation c has invertible components at those terms. Build the diagram isomorphism from asIso(c.app(G_n)); c.naturality gives transition compatibility. Applying the same naturality to the component of a formal morphism and NatTrans.ext proves naturality of the diagram isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Coherence and power annihilation followed by naturality of the individual sheaf comparison, second reader J1.

theorem formalSystem_completed_affine_sections
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)
    let g : S ⟶ Y := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B R)) ≫
      U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι
    let T := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g
    let E := moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)
    let L := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)
    ∃ e : ∀ G : CoherentFormalModule Y J,
      G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1) ≅
        (G.obj ⋙ T ⋙ E) ⋙ L,
      ∀ (G H : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (a : G ⟶ H),
        Functor.whiskerRight a.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≫ (e H).hom =
          (e G).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight
            (Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight a.hom T) E) L
